description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and provides a web interface for monitoring requirements, including displaying a table of requirements, handling user actions for monitoring/unmonitoring, and initializing page and user input. It interacts with requirement and project management classes, generates dynamic content, and manages user permissions.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class used to generate and manage an ExtJS table for displaying requirements.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input parameters from request, validating and retrieving project info.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI data including page title, project name, and requirement IDs.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings such as separator character, charset, and date/time formats.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Generates labels for UI elements based on requirement configuration.

methods.name: buildOnClick
methods.description: Builds JavaScript snippets for monitor/unmonitor actions with appropriate icons and tooltips.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing requirements.
